summary: Cadeler plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated 5 November 2026 announcing the opening of a new office in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. The office will house operations, engineering and technical teams supporting Dutch and broader European offshore wind activity, and becomes the company's fifth global location alongside Copenhagen, Vejle, Norwich and Taipei. No transaction, capital event, ownership change or board recommendation is disclosed; the release describes fleet of 11 jack-up installation vessels and service expansion. No deal terms, no risk-arb angle; purely operational.
